mapper.sql: PROC_DATE, PROC_TIME, PROC_SEQ, BIZ_CD, FILE_SEQ, FILE_NM AS FILE_NAME, ENTITY_ID, DEL_YN, ELEMENT_ID, MASK_YN, TO_CHAR(MASK_DT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MASK_DT, MASK_ORG_ELEMENT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ECM_FILE (PROC_DATE, PROC_TIME, PROC_SEQ, BIZ_CD, FILE_SEQ, FILE_NM, ENTITY_ID, DEL_YN, ELEMENT_ID) VALUES (#{procDate}, #{procTime}, #{procSeq}, #{bizCd}, #{fileSeq}, #{fileName}, #{entityId}, #{delYn}, #{elementId})
mapper.select: SELECT MENU_ID, PARENT_ID, MENU_NM, MENU_URL FROM TB_MENU WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_NO
